subject.title: Slack: Show tool-level progress in assistant thread status

question: Should Slack native assistant thread status show sanitized per-tool progress, or remain generic while existing loading messages, draft previews, and reactions carry progress visibility?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the best behavior is a Slack UX and disclosure-policy choice rather than a narrow broken-code repair.

options.title: Defer Behind Visibility Policy
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide it together with the Slack-safe progress visibility policy before adding native per-tool labels.

options.title: Implement Sanitized Native Status
options.body: Add per-tool native status updates using shared sanitized progress labels, with dedupe, clear behavior, focused tests, and live Slack proof.

options.title: Reject Native Duplication
options.body: Close the native-status direction after documenting that Slack progress should be shown only through loading messages, draft previews, reactions, or task cards.

recommendation.title: Defer Behind Visibility Policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide it together with the Slack-safe progress visibility policy before adding native per-tool labels.
